hook: Maximal Chebyshev hyperelliptic curves are fully classified, tied to when p generates a unit group.
hook_turn: tied to when p generates a unit group.
summary: The paper lists every prime p and finite field over which the hyperelliptic curve y^2 = phi_d(x), built from Chebyshev polynomials, is maximal. For p congruent to 1 mod 4 and odd d, maximality happens exactly when d is a power of a prime l congruent to 1 mod 4 and p generates the unit group mod d. The proof uses Shimura-Taniyama and L-series nonvanishing, and covers only primes not dividing 2d.
title: A Complete Classification of Maximal Hyperelliptic Curves Related to Chebyshev Polynomials
